name: UtilityAIBrain
src_typeComment: Drop alongside TurnBasedActor to make it AI-controlled: on its turn, TurnManager calls ChooseAction(), which scores every candidate action against the current battle state and returns the best one. Add a new enemy behavior by adding a CandidateAction entry in the Inspector — no code needed for simple cases.

src_members.sig: public (ActionDefinition action, TurnBasedActor target) ChooseAction(TurnBasedActor self, IReadOnlyList<TurnBasedActor> enemies, IReadOnlyList<TurnBasedActor> allies)
